Not every lead deserves the same five minutes.

Most owners treat every inquiry the same. Call back fast, ask the same questions, hope it's a fit. That spends your speed, your biggest advantage, on people who were never going to book.

A quiz funnel changes the order. Three questions sit between the ad and the call: budget, timeline, the actual job.

Answers land in your CRM before the phone rings. You call the ready ones first. Everyone else nurtures on its own.

The Black Arrow platform runs quiz funnels straight into your pipeline. No separate tool, no copy-paste.
